question:
Which letter cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series? 

WGVQ, CWHY, ?, OCFO, USRW
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa718dc3d80fa09b3eda3b7ebcb501ae0d35fbb68f85c6fcb0b5de22c71bf85f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccec5a4ecfce95dd1bef18288f80c7967e1b70c56c7974dc159bef3bbeb7fd94.png] 

**Explanation:**

__
 
• The differences are: C - W = 3 - 23 = -20 (or +6 if we cycle through the alphabet) U - O = 21 - 15 = +6
 
• The differences are: W - G = 23 - 7 = +16 S - C = 19 - 3 = +16
 
• The differences are: H - V = 8 - 22 = -14 (or +12 if we cycle through the alphabet) R - F = 18 - 6 = +12__
 
• The differences are: Y - Q = 25 - 17 = +8, W - O = 23 - 15 = +8

Hence, '**IMTG**' is the correct answer.
